pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding positions into failing momentum or high-impact news wicks; pyramiding is limited to 1 scaled addition only after price confirms structural break-even plus 1.5 ATR in profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require minimum 14-period ADX > 25 and volume profile confirmation above VWAP prior to order placement to eliminate low-conviction chop entries.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 and trail remaining volume with a strict dynamic ATR trailing stop to capture +$15.00 to +$30.00 asymmetric tails.
